sections.faq:
How is it free?

We are able to offer a forever free plan by making it ad-supported. Your audience will hear a short audio ad before or during the audio article. You can always switch to our paid plans to remove the advertising. See our full plan list at https://www.getlisten2it.com/pricing/

Which languages are supported?

We support 145+ languages and 500+ voice styles. You can view the full list here:
https://www.getlisten2it.com/pages/text-to-speech-voices

How do I customize the Listen2It Player?

Log in to your Listen2It dashboard (https://dashboard.getlisten2it.com/) and configure the player settings. Once saved, the updated player settings automatically reflect on your website/blog.

How do I change the voice/language which Listen2It uses?

You can log in to your Listen2It dashboard and configure the voice settings. New settings apply to future articles. For older articles, you can manually re-convert them from the dashboard.

If you have many old articles, email support@getlisten2it.com and we will assist. Re-conversions count toward monthly quota.

Does it work for all types of posts?

Yes, the Listen2It player works for all types of posts. You can also disable the player for any post using your Listen2It dashboard.

Can Listen2It convert audio for WordPress pages and custom post types, or is it limited to blog posts only?

Yes! The Listen2It plugin supports:
– WordPress pages
– Custom post types (Portfolios, Lessons, Testimonials, Events, Courses, etc.)
– Standard blog posts

Simply select the post types you want audio enabled for in the plugin settings—no coding needed. This makes it ideal for publishers, e-learning websites, and content-heavy sites.
sections.description: Listen2It helps you convert your articles and blog posts into audio versions instantly and without any effort using lifelike voices in 145+ languages. Listen2It helps you convert your articles and blog posts into audio versions instantly and with zero additional effort using neural-network based lifelike voices in 145+ languages. Simply sign up for a free account and install this WordPress plugin to distribute and publish your content in audio versions on your website/blog and across all popular podcasting platforms. With 500+ voice styles across 145+ languages and advanced voice customization capabilities, you can create your unique brand of voice within minutes. Use our fully customizable SEO-friendly players to create an “on-brand” listening experience for your users. All this with a free account. No credit card is required.
